fields.description: The step's key in suite_cloud.hosting.progress, e.g. mail_records.
fields.label: Step Key

fields.description: What the step does, e.g. Verifying the Mail Domain DNS records. Steps are listed in the order they run; the site domain runs alongside the mail steps.
fields.label: Step

fields.description: Pending: the steps it follows have not finished. Running: started, maybe waiting on a server or on DNS; Detail says what for. Completed: done. Skipped: not needed, e.g. no server or site was created for a site taken from the ready pool. Failed: the request failed here; Retry on the request goes on from this step.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When the step first started. A retry keeps it.
fields.label: Started At

fields.description: When the step completed or failed.
fields.label: Ended At

fields.description: From Started At to Ended At, waiting included: a step that waits on DNS takes as long as the provider does.
fields.label: Duration

fields.description: What a running step waits for, why a step failed or was skipped, or what it chose, e.g. the server a site was placed on.
fields.label: Detail
